 Nintendo eShop and Nintendo Switch Online services are finally available in the Philippines
 The PH is finally an officially supported region by Nintendo!
 By Nicolo Manaloto - November 10, 2026 After its announcement a few weeks ago, Nintendo Switch Online services and the eShop are now officially available in the Philippines .
 Nintendo initially announced its intention to release its online services in the country last year. It may have taken a while, but now, the Philippines is officially a supported region by Nintendo. With this, there’s no need for Filipino Switch players to create accounts in other regions like the US (which has always been the workaround) to access the eShop and online services while in the PH.
 In the Philippines, Switch Online membership plans are priced as follows:
 1-month individual membership (30 days) – PHP 149
 3-month individual membership (90 days) – PHP 399
 12-month individual membership (365 days) – PHP 899
 12-month family membership (365 days) – PHP 1,699
 Meanwhile, here are the subscription prices for Switch Online + Expansion Pack:
 12-month individual membership – PHP 1,799
 12-month family membership – PHP 3,299
 For those unfamiliar, Switch Online allows players to connect with other players, play online, access Nintendo Music, back up saves with Save Data Cloud, and enjoy various Nintendo Classic titles. Meanwhile, Expansion Pack membership gives players access to Nintendo Classic games from Game Boy Advance and Nintendo 64. As for the eShop, Filipino Switch players can now purchase games digitally and pay in Philippine Pesos.
 While Nintendo consoles have long been available in the country, it is only now that online services have officially supported the Philippines. Given this, it’ll be interesting to see if PlayStation does the same, as the Philippines is still not currently supported by the PlayStation Network.
